_comment: The How to play guide (ui/main/how_to_play.gd): one page per tab, each line an icon id from icons.json and a short sentence. Glossary keywords in the text become links. Hand-edited.

lines.text: Each act is a countdown. When it reaches 0 the payload lands and you fight the act's boss.
Take territory before then: every region you hold pays out each day.
Lose three battles in an act, or lose to a boss, and the run is over.
Energy and Material pay for Reinforce, Retreat, Breach and Repair.
Attack a region next to yours. Its Defense sets how hard the fight is.
The Odds lens shows your chance, from simulated fights.
Your regions build Pressure. Reinforce them before it boils over.
The more you take, the higher the Alert: enemies grow stronger and neglected regions Fortify.
The turn order runs along the top: faster units act more often.
Each skill costs Energy, which refills a little every tick up to the Battery.
Enemies show their next move as arrows with numbers. Hover a number for its math.
Pick a skill and every target shows what it would do. Guard and Pierce change the numbers.
Wait to let Energy build for a bigger skill.
Skills a bot uses gain Rank; tier names like Mega mark big steps.
How a bot fights shapes its personality: Aggressive, Defensive, Supportive and more.
The ⋮ on any card, or a right-click, shows everything about it.
